title: Academics — batches, programs, schedule — exact clone parity

surfaces.name: Superadmin Batches List
surfaces.notes: SuperAdmin shell with college-scope gate; delegates to Batches section component

surfaces.name: Create Batch (inline form in list)
surfaces.notes: Form fields: Program (select), Batch Name (input), Start Date (datepicker), End Date (datepicker), Academic Year (auto-derived), Academic year starts in (month selector)

surfaces.name: Edit Batch (modal)
surfaces.notes: Modal title: Edit batch "<name>". Fields same as create plus Status (ACTIVE/INACTIVE/COMPLETED). okText: Save Changes

surfaces.name: Delete Batch (confirmation)
surfaces.notes: Inline Popconfirm. okText: Delete, cancelText: Cancel

surfaces.name: Set Semester for Batch (modal)
surfaces.notes: Modal title: Set current semester — <batchName>. okText: Set semester

surfaces.name: Batch Students Viewer (modal)
surfaces.notes: Legacy: modal with class selector + student list. vNext: dedicated page /admin/batches/[batchId]/students. Functionally equivalent but surface type changed.

surfaces.name: Batch Promotion List
surfaces.notes: Columns: Batch Name, Program, Current Semester, Academic Year, Students, Status, Action

surfaces.name: Promote Batch (modal)
surfaces.notes: Modal title: Promote "<batchName>". okText: Yes, Promote. Has preview/verification step.

surfaces.name: Programs List
surfaces.notes: Columns: Program Name, Duration, Department, Contents, Actions. Search: programs or departments

surfaces.name: Create Program (inline form)
surfaces.notes: Fields: Department (select), Program Name (input), Duration Years (number 1-10)

surfaces.name: Edit Program (modal)
surfaces.notes: Modal title: Edit "<name>". okText: Save Changes, cancelText: Cancel

surfaces.name: Delete Program (confirmation)
surfaces.notes: okText: Delete, cancelText: Cancel

surfaces.name: Departments List
surfaces.notes: Columns: Department Name, Chair, Vice Chair, Contents, Actions. Search: departments

surfaces.name: Create Department (inline form)
surfaces.notes: Fields: College (select, superadmin only), Department Name (input), Department Chair (select, optional), Vice Chair (select, optional)

surfaces.name: Edit Department (modal)
surfaces.notes: Modal title: Edit Department. okText: Save Changes, cancelText: Cancel

surfaces.name: Delete Department (confirmation)
surfaces.notes: okText: Yes, Delete. cancelText: Cancel

surfaces.name: Departments All View
surfaces.notes: Superadmin-only cross-college view

surfaces.name: Semesters List
surfaces.notes: Columns: Program, Semester #, Name, Credits, Courses, Status, Actions. Filter by program.

surfaces.name: Create Semester (inline form)
surfaces.notes: Fields: Program (select), Semester Number (number), Name (input, optional), Total Credits (number, optional)

surfaces.name: Edit Semester (modal)
surfaces.notes: Modal title: Edit Semester. okText: Save Changes

surfaces.name: Delete Semester (confirmation)
surfaces.notes: okText: Yes, cancelText: No

surfaces.name: Semester Course Mapping
surfaces.notes: Program + semester selector. Table: Course Name, Course Code, Credits, Type (mandatory/elective), Order, Actions. Drag-to-reorder.

surfaces.name: Add Courses to Semester (modal)
surfaces.notes: Course multi-select. okText: Add course(s)

surfaces.name: Edit Semester Course Mapping (modal)
surfaces.notes: okText: Save Changes, cancelText: Cancel

surfaces.name: Remove Course from Semester (confirmation)
surfaces.notes: okText: Remove, cancelText: Cancel

surfaces.name: Classes/Sections List
surfaces.notes: Columns: Class/Section Name, Program, Batch, plus capacity, dates, Actions. Filter by program+batch.

surfaces.name: Create Class (inline form)
surfaces.notes: Fields: Program, Batch, Class/Section Name, Description (optional), Start Date, End Date, Max students, Min students

surfaces.name: Edit Class (modal)
surfaces.notes: Same fields as create. okText: Discard edits (cancel discard), Save Changes (save)

surfaces.name: Delete Class (confirmation)
surfaces.notes: Standard Popconfirm

surfaces.name: Create Recurring Sessions (modal)
surfaces.notes: Fields: lecture hall, title, recurring dates/days. Multi-session creation.

surfaces.name: Lecture Halls List
surfaces.notes: Columns: Name, Room Type, Capacity, College, Department, Description, Actions. Types: Classroom, Lecture Hall, Laboratory, Seminar Hall, Auditorium, Conference Room

surfaces.name: Create Lecture Hall (form/modal)
surfaces.notes: Fields: Name, Room Type (select), Capacity (number), College, Department, Description (optional)

surfaces.name: Edit Lecture Hall (modal)
surfaces.notes: Same fields as create

surfaces.name: Delete Lecture Hall (confirmation)
surfaces.notes: okText: Yes, cancelText: No

surfaces.name: Faculty Assignment List
surfaces.notes: Columns: Faculty, Course, Class, Semester, Year, Role (PRIMARY/CO_TEACHER), Active, Actions. Filter: class, course, faculty.

surfaces.name: Create Faculty Assignment (form)
surfaces.notes: Fields: Program, Batch, Semester, Class, Course(s), Faculty, Role, Academic Year, Active

surfaces.name: Edit Faculty Assignment (modal)
surfaces.notes: okText: Save Changes. Discard confirm modal on cancel with unsaved changes.

surfaces.name: Delete Faculty Assignment (confirmation)
surfaces.notes: Title: Delete teaching assignment? Description: This removes the faculty from teaching the listed course. okText: Delete
